scripts.hh:deploy:base:bsc: npx hardhat compile && TARGET_CHAIN=bsc node --import tsx scripts/deploy/base/deploy-bsc.ts
scripts.hh:calldata:base:bsc: npx hardhat compile && TARGET_CHAIN=bsc node --import tsx scripts/deploy/base/build-bsc-calldata.ts
scripts.deps:check-exact: node -e "const p = JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const bad = Object.entries({...p.dependencies,...p.devDependencies}).filter(([,v])=>/[\^~*>]/.test(v)); if(bad.length){console.error('Found range-versioned deps:', bad);process.exit(1)} else { console.log('All deps exact-pinned'); }"
